Game Overview

In Red Stickman vs Craftmans 2, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a pixelated adventure where a stickman battles through a Minecraft-like world teeming with zombie creatures. Engage in fast-paced platforming and shooting action to defeat the infected, rescue Eve, and escape this blocky realm. Can you navigate the chaos and survive?
